semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical equipment and process solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including lithography exposure machines.
summary: Advanced Micro Optics Instruments Inc specializes in providing micro-nano fabrication system solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include production equipment and process solutions for high-end electronic circuits, IC substrates, advanced packaging, MEMS, photovoltaics, and micro-nano device manufacturing.
